# Live Science
> Science news and feature journalism covering space, health, nature, technology, archaeology, physics, and human behavior.

Live Science publishes daily reporting on scientific discoveries, research papers, natural phenomena, medicine, and emerging technology for a general audience. The site is organized around topical news hubs, explainers, features, and interactive content.

## Main Hubs
- [Latest News](https://www.livescience.com/news): Central news feed for recent science discoveries, research coverage, and breaking developments.
- [Space](https://www.livescience.com/space): Coverage of astronomy, cosmology, planets, telescopes, and space exploration missions.
- [Health](https://www.livescience.com/health): Reporting on medicine, disease, genetics, nutrition, and the human body.
- [Planet Earth](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth): Earth science news spanning climate, geology, oceans, weather, and ecosystems.
- [Animals](https://www.livescience.com/animals): Wildlife, zoology, evolution, and animal behavior stories from around the world.
- [Archaeology](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology): Ancient civilizations, excavations, artifacts, fossils, and human origins coverage.
- [Physics & Mathematics](https://www.livescience.com/physics-mathematics): Physics, cosmology, quantum science, and mathematics news and explainers.
- [Technology](https://www.livescience.com/technology): AI, robotics, computing, engineering, and emerging technology reporting.

## Space Topics
- [Astronomy](https://www.livescience.com/space/astronomy): News and articles about stars, galaxies, black holes, and observational astronomy.
- [Space Exploration](https://www.livescience.com/space/space-exploration): Missions, rockets, satellites, and exploration of the solar system and beyond.
- [Skywatching](https://www.livescience.com/space/skywatching): Guides and updates for eclipses, meteor showers, auroras, and night-sky events.
- [Search for Life](https://www.livescience.com/space/search-for-life): Astrobiology, habitable worlds, biosignatures, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
- [The Universe](https://www.livescience.com/space/the-universe): Broad coverage of cosmology, deep space, and the structure of the universe.

## Health Topics
- [Human Body](https://www.livescience.com/health/human-body): Anatomy, physiology, organs, and how the body works.
- [Genetics](https://www.livescience.com/health/genetics): DNA, heredity, gene editing, and genomics research.
- [Neuroscience](https://www.livescience.com/health/neuroscience): Brain science, cognition, nervous system research, and neurological discoveries.
- [Disease](https://www.livescience.com/health/disease): Infectious disease, chronic illness, outbreaks, and medical findings.
- [Nutrition](https://www.livescience.com/health/nutrition): Diet, metabolism, food science, and evidence-based nutrition reporting.
- [Mental Health](https://www.livescience.com/health/mental-health): Psychology, psychiatric research, and mental wellbeing coverage.

## Planet Earth Topics
- [Climate Change](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/climate-change): Research and reporting on warming, emissions, impacts, and climate systems.
- [Weather](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/weather): Storms, heat waves, atmospheric science, and extreme weather events.
- [Oceans & Seas](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/oceans-seas): Marine science, ocean circulation, sea life, and underwater discoveries.
- [Volcanoes & Earthquakes](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/volcanoes-earthquakes): Seismology, eruptions, tectonics, and geologic hazards.
- [Rivers & Lakes](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/rivers-lakes): Freshwater systems, hydrology, and notable lake and river discoveries.
- [Environment](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/environment): Ecosystems, pollution, conservation, and environmental science news.

## Life Sciences
- [Animals](https://www.livescience.com/animals): Animal biology, behavior, ecology, and species discoveries.
- [Evolution](https://www.livescience.com/animals/evolution): Evolutionary biology, adaptation, extinction, and the history of life.
- [Human Behavior](https://www.livescience.com/human-behavior): Psychology, social science, behavior, and cognition reporting.
- [Plants](https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/plants): Botany, plant evolution, ecology, and unusual plant discoveries.
- [Fossils & Ruins](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/fossils-ruins): Fossil finds, ancient remains, and preserved traces of past life.
- [Human Evolution](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/human-evolution): Hominin fossils, ancestry, migration, and early human research.

## Physical Sciences & Technology
- [Physics](https://www.livescience.com/physics-mathematics/physics): Research on matter, energy, forces, and fundamental physical laws.
- [Quantum Physics](https://www.livescience.com/physics-mathematics/quantum-physics): Quantum mechanics, particles, computing, and experimental breakthroughs.
- [Mathematics](https://www.livescience.com/physics-mathematics/mathematics): Mathematical concepts, proofs, puzzles, and applied mathematics stories.
- [Chemistry](https://www.livescience.com/chemistry): Chemical reactions, materials, elements, and molecular science coverage.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.livescience.com/technology/artificial-intelligence): AI systems, machine learning, ethics, and research developments.
- [Robotics](https://www.livescience.com/technology/robotics): Robots, automation, engineering, and autonomous systems reporting.
- [Computing](https://www.livescience.com/technology/computing): Computer science, chips, software, and hardware innovation news.

## Archaeology & History
- [Archaeology](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology): Excavations, artifacts, ancient cultures, and historical discoveries.
- [Ancient Egypt](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/ancient-egypt): Tombs, mummies, pharaohs, and discoveries from ancient Egypt.
- [Ancient Rome](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/ancient-rome): Roman history, archaeology, infrastructure, and empire-era finds.
- [Ancient Greece](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/ancient-greece): Greek archaeology, mythology context, and classical-era discoveries.
- [Vikings](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/vikings): Viking archaeology, settlements, voyages, and Norse history.
- [Maya](https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/maya): Maya civilization research, ruins, inscriptions, and cultural discoveries.

## Features, Explainers & Reference
- [Features](https://www.livescience.com/features): In-depth feature stories, long-form reporting, and broader scientific context.
- [References](https://www.livescience.com/reference): Reference-style explainers answering common science questions and concepts.
- [About Us](https://www.livescience.com/about-us): Editorial mission, team information, and background on the publication.
- [Topics](https://www.livescience.com/topics): Topic directory for browsing Live Science subject areas and recurring coverage.
- [Authors](https://www.livescience.com/author): Staff and contributor profile directory for site journalism and expertise.

## Interactive & Puzzles
- [Quizzes](https://www.livescience.com/quizzes): Science quizzes and trivia covering animals, space, health, and general knowledge.
- [Live Science Crossword Puzzle](https://www.livescience.com/human-behavior/arts-entertainment/live-science-crossword-puzzle): Recurring science-themed crossword for readers who want interactive word puzzles.
- [The Ultimate Alien Quiz](https://www.livescience.com/quizzes/the-ultimate-alien-quiz): Trivia quiz focused on extraterrestrials, astrobiology, and science-fiction-adjacent knowledge.
- [Animal Quiz](https://www.livescience.com/quizzes/animal-quiz): Interactive quiz testing knowledge of wildlife, biology, and animal behavior.
- [Space Quiz](https://www.livescience.com/quizzes/space-quiz): Quiz content about planets, astronomy, missions, and the wider universe.
